name: Honda VTX1800
engine: 1795 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: Honda's huge-torque cruiser. Check the rear wheel and final drive flange bearings, a common owner complaint.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some early 2002 VTX1800s were recalled for a swingarm weld and a transmission circlip.
A-002.reason: Both can cause a crash. Repairs are free.

add.title: Check the rear wheel and final drive bearings
add.instructions: With the rear wheel out, check the wheel bearings and the final drive flange bearing for roughness or play.
add.reason: Owners report worn flange bearings on these bikes, often found at a tire change.

recallNote: No recalls found for these years when this course was written. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls to be sure.

known.title: Rear flange bearings
known.what: Final drive flange and rear wheel bearings wear early on many VTX1800s.
